capabilities.body: OpenAmer yi kunguhata ntiro, yi wu endla hi switirhisiwa swa xiviri — theminali, xihlamusela-marito xa webu, tifayili, khodi — kutani yi hlayisa leswi tirhaka.
capabilities.title: Ejente leyi ehleketaka na wena

capabilities.body: Mimbulavurisano, miehleketo leyi hlayisiweke ni timodeli swi le ka muchini lowu. A ku rhumeriwi xilo handle ko va u swi komberile.
capabilities.title: Switirhisiwa swa wena, datha ya wena

capabilities.body: Tindzimi ta 186, yin'wana ni yin'wana hi matsalelo lawa u ma hlayaka. Xikombiso xo sungula xa app xi ku vutisa leswaku u lava rihi.
capabilities.title: Ririmi ra wena, hi ndlela leyi faneleke

capabilities.body: Vuswikoti byi hlayisiwa eka ntiro lowu endliwaka, leswaku mintirho ya siku ni siku yi hatlisa loko u ya u yi tirhisa.
capabilities.title: Vuswikoti byo kula

help: Kambela leswaku muchini lowu wu kota ku nghena eka inthanete.
Tlhela u sungula malulamiselo — magoza lama hetiweke a ma phindhiwi.
Loko swi tsandza kambirhi, pfula tirhekhodo; tilayini to hetelela ti vula goza leri tsandzekeke.
failure.lead: Ku hava ku cinca loku tlheriseriweke endzhaku exihundleni — OpenAmer yi yima laha yi yimeke kona, leswaku loko yi tlhela yi tirhisiwa yi ya mahlweni ku suka kwalaho.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ya ha ri eka nkandziyiso wa khale naswona ya ha tirha. A ku cinciwanga xilo xi sala xi nga helanga.
failure.title: Malulamiselo a ma helanga

language.lead: Malulamiselo ma ya mahlweni hi ririmi leri u ri hlawulaka laha. U nga ri cinca endzhaku eka app.
language.title: Hlawula ririmi ra wena

progress.lead: Malulamiselo ya kan'we: OpenAmer yi dawuniloda leswi yi swi lavaka ni ku lulamisa muchini lowu. Loko yi sungula enkarhini lowu taka, yi ta tlulela leswi hinkwaro.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer yi siva nkandziyiso wa khale. Tiseshini, miehleketo leyi hlayisiweke ni swiyimiso swa wena a swi cinciwi.
progress.title: Ku lulamisa OpenAmer

stages.node-deps: Ku nghenisa swiengetelo leswi lavekaka swa Node.js

cards.body: Pfula app kutani u hlamusela leswi u lavaka swi endliwa. OpenAmer yi tirha endzhaku kutani yi ku vikela.
cards.title: Sungula hi xivulwa

cards.body: Swiyimiso → Nkombiso → Ririmi. Tindzimi ta 186, leti u nga ti cincaka nkarhi wihi na wihi.
cards.title: Hlawula ririmi ra wena

cards.body: Ntiro lowu phindhiwaka wu hundzuka vuswikoti — enkarhini lowu taka wu lava xileriso xin'we ntsena.
cards.title: Yi pfumelele yi tsundzuka

success.command: kumbe yi sungule endzhaku eka theminali:
success.errorTitle: A swi kotekanga ku sungula app ya khompyuta
success.lead: Hinkwaswo swi lulamile. OpenAmer sweswi i ya wena — eka muchini lowu, hi ririmi ra wena.
success.title: OpenAmer yi lunghekile

bullets: Yi tirha laha — mimbulavurisano ya wena yi sala eka muchini lowu

welcome.lead: Ejente ya wena. Eka switirhisiwa swa wena. Hi ririmi ra wena.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer leyintshwa yi lunghekile. Yi siva nkandziyiso wa khale yi hlayisa seshini yin'wana ni yin'wana ni swiyimiso.
welcome.note: Swi teka timinete ti nga ri tingani eka vuhlanganisi bya ntolovelo.
welcome.title: Amukelekile eka OpenAmer
